import.description: Download the ePubLibre catalog and create or update your local library.
import.sourceDescription: The server downloads the ZIP from the configured source and extracts the CSV for processing.
import.behaviour: Updating adds new books and modifies existing ones. It also handles the first import, preserving download history and books absent from the CSV.
import.previewNote: Preview does not modify the database. Each operation downloads the catalog again; the update may differ from the preview if the source or data changes.
import.pendingDescription: This may take several minutes. You can browse other screens and return here; keep this tab open to receive the result.
import.networkError: The connection to the server was lost.
import.httpError: The server returned an error (HTTP {{status}}). Check the logs for details.
import.unexpectedError: The response could not be processed. Check the server logs.
import.uncertain: The update may have run even though its result was not received. Check the catalog before trying again. It has not been retried automatically.
import.unsuccessful: The server has not confirmed a successful operation. Check the logs for details.
import.partial: Operation completed with skipped rows. Review the error count and logs.
import.previewDone: Preview complete. The database has not been modified.
import.updateDone: Catalog updated. The new data is now available.
import.confirmDescription: The catalog will be downloaded again and new or changed books will be saved. Existing books absent from the CSV and download history will be preserved.
import.firstLoad: Import the catalog for the first time

reset.title: Reset the entire database
reset.description: Download the ZIP/CSV and rebuild the catalog from scratch. Delete download history, jobs and their items, and update plans and cleanup records.
reset.kept: Does not delete qBittorrent torrents or files. Server configuration, logs and browser preferences are preserved. If downloading or importing fails, the previous database is preserved.
reset.busy: Operations or sends are in progress. Wait for them to finish; if jobs are sending torrents, pause or cancel them before trying again. The database has not been reset.
reset.uncertain: The reset result could not be confirmed. Check the catalog and logs before trying again. The operation has not been retried automatically.
reset.done: Database reset and catalog imported from scratch.
reset.confirmDescription: This action is irreversible. The ZIP/CSV will be downloaded and the catalog rebuilt from scratch. Download history, jobs (including queued or paused jobs), and update plans and cleanup records will be deleted. qBittorrent torrents and files will not be touched.

torrent.title: Torrent client connection
torrent.description: Check the connection using the server configuration. Does not add torrents or modify downloads.
torrent.disabled: Torrent integration is disabled on the server.
torrent.connected: Successfully connected to the torrent client.
torrent.disconnected: The torrent client is not connected.
torrent.timeout: The connection timed out. Check that the client is reachable.
torrent.upstream: The client rejected authentication or did not return a valid response. Review the configuration and server details.
torrent.interrupted: The check was interrupted or the service is unavailable.
torrent.network: Could not reach EPL Sync. Check your connection and try again.

directory.note: Browse catalog values. Grouped authors and genres are displayed as they appear in the source.

downloads.localNote: Status recorded in EPL Sync. Sync to query the torrent client and update these records.
downloads.httpError: The server responded with HTTP {{status}}. Review the details before repeating the operation.
downloads.uncertain: No valid result was received. The operation may have completed: check Status and Jobs before repeating it. There is no automatic retry.
downloads.recordsNote: Download records: a book may have multiple revisions or destinations.
downloads.jobNote: These jobs control EPL Sync submissions. An accepted submission does not mean a completed download. Pausing or cancelling a job does not stop torrents already submitted.
downloads.cancelConfirm: Pending items will be cancelled. In-flight submissions may finish and already submitted torrents will not be changed.
downloads.jobNotFound: This job could not be found. It may have been removed by a database reset.
downloads.refreshError: Could not refresh the view. Check your connection and try again.

send.individualNote: Find a book, select it and review the options before submitting it to the torrent client.
send.multipleNote: Filter books and review the selection. Multiple submissions create a job you can monitor and control.
send.acceptedNote: The client accepted the submission or already knows the torrent. Open Status and sync to track the download.
send.allMatchesNote: ALL books matching the filters will be submitted, not just this page. This preview does not submit torrents or reserve the catalog.
send.allCatalog: I want to submit the entire catalog, without filters.
send.noHash: This book has no valid hashes to submit.
send.defaults: Unchanged options inherit the server configuration.
send.pathError: An explicit path requires automatic management to be disabled.
send.emptyOverrides: An empty category or tag list with override enabled clears that default value.
send.confirmMultiple_one: Submit {{count}} book matching the selected filters.
send.confirmMultiple_other: Submit {{count}} books matching the selected filters.
send.liveSelection: The catalog is queried again on confirmation; results may differ if it has changed since the preview.
send.dirty: Filters have changed. Preview the selection again before submitting.
send.running: Submission in progress. You can continue browsing.
send.finished: Submission processed. Check the result in Status or Jobs.

covers.title: Check covers
covers.description: Check catalog covers. Conclusive results are saved and missing covers use an alternative cover. Temporary errors preserve the previous state.
covers.parametersNote: These values apply only to this run; they do not change the server configuration.
covers.connectTimeoutMsHelp: Time limit for establishing a new connection.
covers.requestTimeoutMsHelp: Time budget per cover, including redirects.
covers.batchTimeoutMsHelp: Time limit for a group of simultaneous requests.
covers.concurrencyHelp: Between 1 and 32. More requests may trigger remote server limits.
covers.invalidOptions: Use times between 0.001 and 300 seconds, with connection ≤ cover ≤ group, and between 1 and 32 simultaneous checks.
covers.startError: Could not confirm the task started. Check its status before trying again; another check may already be running.
covers.testMode: Preview mode: changes are not saved.
covers.saveMode: Repair mode: conclusive results are saved.
covers.background: You can leave this view or close the browser: the server keeps working. The task and summary are retained until the server restarts.
covers.taskError: The task could not complete. Another check or maintenance operation may be running. Check the server log before trying again.
covers.alreadyAlternative: This book already uses the alternative cover.
covers.repaired: The alternative cover has been enabled.
covers.repairError: Could not complete the check. No change has been confirmed.
covers.forceDescription: If the image is incorrect, you can mark the original cover as unavailable and use the alternative cover. The original URL will be preserved.
covers.forceError: Could not confirm the change. The cover may have changed; refresh the view before trying again.

reasons.AVAILABLE: The server reports an available image, so the cover was not marked as missing.
reasons.TIMEOUT: The server did not respond within the time limit. Cover availability could not be determined.
reasons.TIMEOUT_OR_NETWORK_ERROR: The check timed out or encountered a connection problem.
reasons.NETWORK_ERROR: Could not connect to the image server.
reasons.HTTP_ERROR: The server returned HTTP {{status}}. This does not confirm that the cover is missing.
reasons.NOT_AN_IMAGE: The server did not identify the response as an image. The result is inconclusive.
reasons.INVALID_URL: The cover URL cannot be checked.
reasons.INVALID_REDIRECT: The server returned a redirect that cannot be followed.
reasons.TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS: The redirect limit was reached without a conclusive result.
reasons.CONCURRENT_CHANGE: The cover changed during the check. Refresh the view before trying again.
reasons.CHECK_ERROR: Could not complete the check. The cover has not been confirmed as unavailable.
reasons.UNKNOWN: The cover could not be confirmed as unavailable.
reasons.NO_COVER: No cover URL was found to check. Refresh the view to see the current book state.

covers.includeReviewedHelp: Turn this off to check only covers that have not been reviewed.
